problems: The coil does not read as a coil. Its four turns are only 0.03 apart in y, but the rope is 0.06 thick, so they merge into one thick ring. Next to the loop, the whole object reads as a pair of spectacles, not a coiled lasso. The turns need to be gathered at the top and fan out below so each turn shows.

The tie can't bind the bundle. It is two round rings, 0.085 in radius, with a single rope's worth of room inside, set in the yz plane. Once the turns are spaced so they show, the bundle is wider than that. It needs a band shaped to the bundle.

The construction is wrong at the honda. The lead from the coil ends at the eye, and the loop is a separate tube starting at the same point, so two rope ends just meet there. On a real lasso, one rope runs from the coil, through the honda eye, round the big loop, and ends at the eye, which is tied on the rope's end. Make it one continuous rope with the eye at the loop's far end.

The hand coil reads as a metal coil spring: its four turns are equally sized, evenly spaced and perfectly round. The fan-out (0.015) is too small to see, so the turns never differ in size, spread apart or sag below the tie the way a rope coil does.
The free end is a short, stiff, straight stub with a sharp kink where it leaves the coil; a soft rope end should be longer and hang in a gentle curve.
